-- Copyright (c) 2022 ASX Operations Pty Ltd. All rights reserved.

module Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Allocation(
  AllocationChangeRule(..),
  AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextAllocation(..),
  AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation(..),
  AllocationDetails(..),
  DeallocationDetails(..),
  AllocationChangeInstruction(..),
  AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive(..),
  AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation(..),
  AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation(..),
  AllocationChangeInstruction_Process(..)
) where

import DA.Action (unless)
import DA.Assert ((===))
import DA.Finance.Asset
import DA.Finance.Types
import qualified DA.Foldable as F
import DA.List
import qualified DA.List.Total as LT
import qualified DA.Optional as O
import DA.Set (Set)
import qualified DA.Set as Set
import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Custody

-- | Rule to allow an account owner to confirm or reject instructions to allocate (credit) or deallocate (debit) from
-- their account.
template AllocationChangeRule
  with
    account : Account -- ^ Account to which this rule applies.
  where
    signatory account.id.signatories
    observer account.owner

    key account.id : Id
    maintainer key.signatories

    -- | Consent to an allocation into the account.
    nonconsuming choice AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextAllocation : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction
      with
        allocationChangeInstructionCid : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction -- ^ Contract ID of the proposed allocation.
      controller account.owner
      do
        allocationChangeInstruction <- fetch allocationChangeInstructionCid
        let (_, unconfirmedAllocations) = splitAllocations allocationChangeInstruction.allocations
        (head unconfirmedAllocations).account === account
        exercise allocationChangeInstructionCid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation

    -- | Consent to a deallocation from the account.
    nonconsuming choice AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction
      with
        allocationChangeInstructionCid : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction -- ^ Contract ID of the proposed deallocation.
        depositCid : ContractId AssetDeposit -- ^ Asset deposit to be archived during processing of the deallocation.
      controller account.owner
      do
        allocationChangeInstruction <- fetch allocationChangeInstructionCid
        let (_, unconfirmedDeallocations) = splitDeallocations allocationChangeInstruction.deallocations
        (head unconfirmedDeallocations).account === account
        exercise allocationChangeInstructionCid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid

-- | Allocation to a particular account.
data AllocationDetails = AllocationDetails
  with
    account : Account -- ^ Account to allocate to.
    confirmed : Bool -- ^ 'True' if the account signatories have consented to the allocation, otherwise 'False'.
  deriving (Show, Eq)

splitAllocations : [AllocationDetails] -> ([AllocationDetails], [AllocationDetails])
splitAllocations = partition (\allocation -> allocation.confirmed)

allocationSignatories : [AllocationDetails] -> [Party]
allocationSignatories = concatMap (\detail -> Set.toList detail.account.id.signatories)

-- | Deallocation from a particular account.
data DeallocationDetails = DeallocationDetails
  with
   account : Account -- ^ Account to deallocate from.
   depositCid : Optional (ContractId AssetDeposit) -- ^ Deposit to be archived. Will be 'Some' if the account
   -- signatories have consented to the deallocation.
  deriving (Show, Eq)

splitDeallocations : [DeallocationDetails] -> ([DeallocationDetails], [DeallocationDetails])
splitDeallocations = partition (\deallocationDetails -> O.isSome deallocationDetails.depositCid)

deallocationSignatories : [DeallocationDetails] -> [Party]
deallocationSignatories = concatMap (\deallocation -> Set.toList deallocation.account.id.signatories)

assertIsLeafNode : Account -> Update ()
assertIsLeafNode account = do
  custodialRole <- lookupByKey @CustodianRole account.id
  custodialRole === None

assertAtHierarchyTop : Account -> Update ()
assertAtHierarchyTop account = do
  (_, topCustodyAgreement) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement account.id
  rootCustodyAgreement <- lookupByKey @CustodyAgreement topCustodyAgreement.parent.id
  rootCustodyAgreement === None

getParent : Account -> Update Account
getParent account = do
  (_, custodyAgreement) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement account.id
  pure custodyAgreement.parent

-- | A call to allocate and/or deallocate from an account hierarchy.
template AllocationChangeInstruction
  with
    asset : Asset -- ^ Quantity and identifier of the asset to allocate and/or deallocate.
    deallocations : [DeallocationDetails] -- ^ Deallocations from bottom to top of the hierarchy.
    allocations : [AllocationDetails] -- ^ Allocations from top to bottom of the hierarchy.
    masterAgreement : MasterAgreement -- ^ Master agreement under which this applies.
    tradeId : Id -- ^ Trade this allocation change is linked to.
    observers : Set Party -- ^ Contract observers.
  where
    signatory masterAgreement.id.signatories,
      deallocationSignatories confirmedDeallocations,
      allocationSignatories confirmedAllocations
    observer masterAgreement.party1,
      masterAgreement.party2,
      deallocationSignatories unconfirmedDeallocations,
      allocationSignatories unconfirmedAllocations,
      observers

    key (masterAgreement.id, tradeId, asset.id) : (Id, Id, Id)
    maintainer key._1.signatories

    let (confirmedDeallocations, unconfirmedDeallocations) = splitDeallocations deallocations
        (confirmedAllocations, unconfirmedAllocations) = splitAllocations allocations

    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive : ()
      controller masterAgreement.id.signatories
      do
        pure ()

    -- | Account signatories of the next unconfirmed allocation can choose to consent to the allocation change. Can
    -- only be exercised after all deallocations are confirmed.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction
      controller (head unconfirmedAllocations).account.id.signatories
      do
        unconfirmedDeallocations === []
        let nextAllocation = head unconfirmedAllocations
        create this with
          allocations = confirmedAllocations <> ((nextAllocation with confirmed = True) :: tail unconfirmedAllocations)

    -- | Account signatories of the next unconfirmed deallocation can choose to consent to the allocation change.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction
      with
        depositCid : ContractId AssetDeposit -- ^ Deposit to archived during exercise of
        -- 'AllocationChangeInstruction_Process'.
      controller (head unconfirmedDeallocations).account.id.signatories
      do
        allocation <- fetch depositCid
        allocation.asset === asset
        let nextDeallocation = head unconfirmedDeallocations
        allocation.account === nextDeallocation.account
        let updatedNextDeallocation = nextDeallocation with depositCid = Some depositCid
        create this with
          deallocations = confirmedDeallocations <> (updatedNextDeallocation :: tail unconfirmedDeallocations)

    -- | Execute the allocation changes.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_Process : [ContractId AssetDeposit]
      controller masterAgreement.id.signatories
      do
        unless (null deallocations) do
          F.forA_ (zip deallocations (tail deallocations)) $ \(deallocation, nextDeallocation) -> do
            (_, custodialSerivce) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement deallocation.account.id
            custodialSerivce.parent === nextDeallocation.account
          F.mapA_ (\deallocation -> archive $ O.fromSome deallocation.depositCid) deallocations
          assertIsLeafNode (head deallocations).account

        unless (null allocations) do
          F.forA_ (zip allocations (tail allocations)) $ \(allocation, nextAllocation) -> do
            (_, custodyAgreement)

module Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Custody where

import DA.Finance.Types
import DA.Set (Set)
import qualified DA.Set as Set

-- | Agreement between beneficiary and custodian.
template CustodyAgreement
  with
    parent : Account -- ^ Account in which the custodian keeps assets of clients for safe-keeping.
    account : Account -- ^ Account owned by a beneficiary, which is allocated some portion of the assets in the
      -- parent account.
    observers : Set Party
  where
    signatory account.id.signatories, parent.id.signatories
    observer account.owner, observers

    ensure account.provider == parent.owner

    key account.id : Id
    maintainer key.signatories

    -- | Update contract observers.
    choice CustodyAgreement_SetObservers : ContractId CustodyAgreement
      with
        newObservers : Set Party -- ^ Updated contract observers.
      controller account.owner
      do
        create this with observers = newObservers

-- | A request made to a custodian by a party seeking to act as a beneficiary of assets.
template CustodyRequest
  with
    parent : Account -- ^ Account in which the custodian keeps assets of clients for safe-keeping.
    account : Account -- ^ Account of prospective beneficiary.
  where
    signatory account.id.signatories
    observer parent.owner

    -- | Accept the request and create the 'CustodyAgreement'.
    choice CustodyRequest_Accept : ContractId CustodyAgreement
      controller parent.owner
      do
        exerciseByKey @CustodianRole parent.id CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with account

    -- | Cancel the request.
    choice CustodyRequest_Cancel : ()
      controller account.id.signatories
      do
        pure ()

    -- | Reject the request.
    choice CustodyRequest_Reject : ()
      controller parent.owner
      do
        pure ()

-- | Contract in which the account signatories allow the account owner to delegate beneficial ownership of assets in
-- the account to other parties. This contract also signifies that the account is not a leaf node in the tree.
template CustodianRole
  with
    parent : Account -- ^ Owner of this account can choose to enter 'CustodyAgreement' contracts (with this as the
    -- 'parent' account).
    observers : Set Party -- ^ Contract observers.
  where
    signatory parent.id.signatories
    observer parent.provider, parent.owner, observers

    key parent.id : Id
    maintainer key.signatories

    -- | Accept a request to act as a custodian.
    nonconsuming choice CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement : ContractId CustodyAgreement
      with
        account : Account -- ^ Account of beneficiary.
      controller parent.owner, account.id.signatories
      do
        create CustodyAgreement with parent, account, observers = Set.empty

<- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement nextAllocation.account.id
            custodyAgreement.parent === allocation.account
          assertIsLeafNode (last allocations).account

        case (LT.last deallocations, LT.head allocations) of
          (Some topDeallocation, Some topAllocation) -> do
            deallocationParent <- getParent topDeallocation.account
            allocationParent <- getParent topAllocation.account
            unless (deallocationParent == allocationParent) do
              assertAtHierarchyTop topDeallocation.account
              assertAtHierarchyTop topAllocation.account
          (Some topDeallocation, None) -> assertAtHierarchyTop topDeallocation.account
          (None, Some topAllocation) -> assertAtHierarchyTop topAllocation.account
          (None, None) -> pure ()

        mapA (\step -> create AssetDeposit with account = step.account, asset, observers = Set.empty) allocations

splitAllocations : [AllocationDetails] -> ([AllocationDetails], [AllocationDetails])
splitAllocations = partition (\allocation -> allocation.confirmed)

allocationSignatories : [AllocationDetails] -> [Party]
allocationSignatories = concatMap (\detail -> Set.toList detail.account.id.signatories)

-- | Deallocation from a particular account.
data DeallocationDetails = DeallocationDetails
  with
   account : Account -- ^ Account to deallocate from.
   depositCid : Optional (ContractId AssetDeposit) -- ^ Deposit to be archived. Will be 'Some' if the account
   -- signatories have consented to the deallocation.
  deriving (Show, Eq)

splitDeallocations : [DeallocationDetails] -> ([DeallocationDetails], [DeallocationDetails])
splitDeallocations = partition (\deallocationDetails -> O.isSome deallocationDetails.depositCid)

deallocationSignatories : [DeallocationDetails] -> [Party]
deallocationSignatories = concatMap (\deallocation -> Set.toList deallocation.account.id.signatories)

assertIsLeafNode : Account -> Update ()
assertIsLeafNode account = do
  custodialRole <- lookupByKey @CustodianRole account.id
  custodialRole === None

assertAtHierarchyTop : Account -> Update ()
assertAtHierarchyTop account = do
  (_, topCustodyAgreement) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement account.id
  rootCustodyAgreement <- lookupByKey @CustodyAgreement topCustodyAgreement.parent.id
  rootCustodyAgreement === None

getParent : Account -> Update Account
getParent account = do
  (_, custodyAgreement) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement account.id
  pure custodyAgreement.parent

-- | A call to allocate and/or deallocate from an account hierarchy.
template AllocationChangeInstruction
  with
    asset : Asset -- ^ Quantity and identifier of the asset to allocate and/or deallocate.
    deallocations : [DeallocationDetails] -- ^ Deallocations from bottom to top of the hierarchy.
    allocations : [AllocationDetails] -- ^ Allocations from top to bottom of the hierarchy.
    masterAgreement : MasterAgreement -- ^ Master agreement under which this applies.
    tradeId : Id -- ^ Trade this allocation change is linked to.
    observers : Set Party -- ^ Contract observers.
  where
    signatory masterAgreement.id.signatories,
      deallocationSignatories confirmedDeallocations,
      allocationSignatories confirmedAllocations
    observer masterAgreement.party1,
      masterAgreement.party2,
      deallocationSignatories unconfirmedDeallocations,
      allocationSignatories unconfirmedAllocations,
      observers

    key (masterAgreement.id, tradeId, asset.id) : (Id, Id, Id)
    maintainer key._1.signatories

    let (confirmedDeallocations, unconfirmedDeallocations) = splitDeallocations deallocations
        (confirmedAllocations, unconfirmedAllocations) = splitAllocations allocations

    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive : ()
      controller masterAgreement.id.signatories
      do
        pure ()

    -- | Account signatories of the next unconfirmed allocation can choose to consent to the allocation change. Can
    -- only be exercised after all deallocations are confirmed.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction
      controller (head unconfirmedAllocations).account.id.signatories
      do
        unconfirmedDeallocations === []
        let nextAllocation = head unconfirmedAllocations
        create this with
          allocations = confirmedAllocations <> ((nextAllocation with confirmed = True) :: tail unconfirmedAllocations)

    -- | Account signatories of the next unconfirmed deallocation can choose to consent to the allocation change.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction
      with
        depositCid : ContractId AssetDeposit -- ^ Deposit to archived during exercise of
        -- 'AllocationChangeInstruction_Process'.
      controller (head unconfirmedDeallocations).account.id.signatories
      do
        allocation <- fetch depositCid
        allocation.asset === asset
        let nextDeallocation = head unconfirmedDeallocations
        allocation.account === nextDeallocation.account
        let updatedNextDeallocation = nextDeallocation with depositCid = Some depositCid
        create this with
          deallocations = confirmedDeallocations <> (updatedNextDeallocation :: tail unconfirmedDeallocations)

    -- | Execute the allocation changes.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_Process : [ContractId AssetDeposit]
      controller masterAgreement.id.signatories
      do
        unless (null deallocations) do
          F.forA_ (zip deallocations (tail deallocations)) $ \(deallocation, nextDeallocation) -> do
            (_, custodialSerivce) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement deallocation.account.id
            custodialSerivce.parent === nextDeallocation.account
          F.mapA_ (\deallocation -> archive $ O.fromSome deallocation.depositCid) deallocations
          assertIsLeafNode (head deallocations).account

        unless (null allocations) do
          F.forA_ (zip allocations (tail allocations)) $ \(allocation, nextAllocation) -> do
            (_, custodyAgreement) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement nextAllocation.account.id
            custodyAgreement.parent === allocation.account
          assertIsLeafNode (last allocations).account

        case (LT.last deallocations, LT.head allocations) of
          (Some topDeallocation, Some topAllocation) -> do
            deallocationParent <- getParent topDeallocation.account
            allocationParent <- getParent topAllocation.account
            unless (deallocationParent == allocationParent) do
              assertAtHierarchyTop topDeallocation.account
              assertAtHierarchyTop topAllocation.account
          (Some topDeallocation, None) -> assertAtHierarchyTop topDeallocation.account
          (None, Some topAllocation) -> assertAtHierarchyTop topAllocation.account
          (None, None) -> pure ()

        mapA (\step -> create AssetDeposit with account = step.account, asset, observers = Set.empty) allocations

module Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Custody where

import DA.Finance.Types
import DA.Set (Set)
import qualified DA.Set as Set

-- | Agreement between beneficiary and custodian.
template CustodyAgreement
  with
    parent : Account -- ^ Account in which the custodian keeps assets of clients for safe-keeping.
    account : Account -- ^ Account owned by a beneficiary, which is allocated some portion of the assets in the
      -- parent account.
    observers : Set Party
  where
    signatory account.id.signatories, parent.id.signatories
    observer account.owner, observers

    ensure account.provider == parent.owner

    key account.id : Id
    maintainer key.signatories

    -- | Update contract observers.
    choice CustodyAgreement_SetObservers : ContractId CustodyAgreement
      with
        newObservers : Set Party -- ^ Updated contract observers.
      controller account.owner
      do
        create this with observers = newObservers

-- | A request made to a custodian by a party seeking to act as a beneficiary of assets.
template CustodyRequest
  with
    parent : Account -- ^ Account in which the custodian keeps assets of clients for safe-keeping.
    account : Account -- ^ Account of prospective beneficiary.
  where
    signatory account.id.signatories
    observer parent.owner

    -- | Accept the request and create the 'CustodyAgreement'.
    choice CustodyRequest_Accept : ContractId CustodyAgreement
      controller parent.owner
      do
        exerciseByKey @CustodianRole parent.id CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with account

    -- | Cancel the request.
    choice CustodyRequest_Cancel : ()
      controller account.id.signatories
      do
        pure ()

    -- | Reject the request.
    choice CustodyRequest_Reject : ()
      controller parent.owner
      do
        pure ()

-- | Contract in which the account signatories allow the account owner to delegate beneficial ownership of assets in
-- the account to other parties. This contract also signifies that the account is not a leaf node in the tree.
template CustodianRole
  with
    parent : Account -- ^ Owner of this account can choose to enter 'CustodyAgreement' contracts (with this as the
    -- 'parent' account).
    observers : Set Party -- ^ Contract observers.
  where
    signatory parent.id.signatories
    observer parent.provider, parent.owner, observers

    key parent.id : Id
    maintainer key.signatories

    -- | Accept a request to act as a custodian.
    nonconsuming choice CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement : ContractId CustodyAgreement
      with
        account : Account -- ^ Account of beneficiary.
      controller parent.owner, account.id.signatories
      do
        create CustodyAgreement with parent, account, observers = Set.empty

import DA.Finance.Types
import qualified DA.Set as Set
import Daml.Script

data Parties = Parties
  with
    alice : Party
    bob : Party
    charlie : Party
    david : Party
    eve : Party
    fred : Party
  deriving (Show, Eq)

allocateParties : Script Parties
allocateParties = Parties <$>
  allocateParty "Alice" <*>
  allocateParty "Bob" <*>
  allocateParty "Charlie" <*>
  allocateParty "David" <*>
  allocateParty "Eve" <*>
  allocateParty "Fred"

withParties : (Parties -> Script ()) -> Script ()
withParties test = do
  parties <- allocateParties
  test parties

allParties : Parties -> [Party]
allParties parties = [parties.alice, parties.bob, parties.charlie, parties.david, parties.eve, parties.fred]

acc : IsParties p => p -> Party -> Party -> Account
acc sigs provider owner =
  let sigsSet = Set.fromList $ toParties sigs in
  Account with
    id = Id with
      label = "signatories: " <> show sigsSet <> ", provider: " <> show provider <> ", owner: " <> show owner
      signatories = sigsSet
      version = 0
    owner
    provider

test_CustodyAgreement_signatories : Script ()
test_CustodyAgreement_signatories = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let custodyAgreement = CustodyAgreement with
        parent = acc parties.alice parties.charlie parties.charlie
        account = acc parties.bob parties.charlie parties.charlie
        observers = Set.fromList [parties.eve]
  Set.fromList (signatory custodyAgreement) === Set.fromList [parties.alice, parties.bob]

test_CustodyAgreement_observers : Script ()
test_CustodyAgreement_observers = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let custodyAgreement = CustodyAgreement with
        parent = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.alice
        account = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.bob
        observers = Set.fromList [parties.charlie, parties.david]
  Set.fromList (observer custodyAgreement) === Set.fromList [parties.bob, parties.charlie, parties.david]

test_CustodyAgreement_ensure : Script ()
test_CustodyAgreement_ensure = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let custodyAgreement = CustodyAgreement with
        parent = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.alice
        account = acc parties.alice parties.bob parties.alice
        observers = Set.empty
  ensure custodyAgreement === False
  ensure (custodyAgreement with account.provider = parties.alice) === True

test_CustodyAgreement_SetObservers : Script ()
test_CustodyAgreement_SetObservers = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let custodyAgreement = CustodyAgreement with
        parent = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.alice
        account = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.bob
        observers = Set.fromList [parties.bob, parties.charlie]
  custodyAgreementCid <- submitMulti [parties.alice, parties.bob] [] do createCmd custodyAgreement
  submitMustFail parties.alice do
    exerciseCmd custodyAgreementCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with newObservers = Set.fromList [parties.david]
  submit parties.bob do
    exerciseCmd custodyAgreementCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with newObservers = Set.fromList [parties.david]
  [(_, newCustodyAgreement)] <- query parties.alice
  newCustodyAgreement === custodyAgreement with observers = Set.fromList [parties.david]

test_CustodyRequest_signatories : Script ()
test_CustodyRequest_signatories = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let account = acc [parties.alice] parties.bob parties.bob
  let parent = acc [parties.charlie] parties.david parties.david
  let custodyRequest = CustodyRequest with account, parent
  Set.fromList (signatory custodyRequest) === Set.fromList [parties.alice]

test_CustodyRequest_Accept : Script ()
test_CustodyRequest_Accept = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let account = acc [parties.alice] parties.bob parties.bob
  let parent = acc [parties.charlie] parties.bob parties.bob
  let custodyRequest = CustodyRequest with account, parent
  custodyRequestCid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd custodyRequest
  -- Bob doesn't have a CustodianRole so he cannot accept the request
  submitMustFail parties.bob do
    exerciseCmd custodyRequestCid CustodyRequest_Accept
  custodianRoleCid <- submit parties.charlie do createCmd CustodianRole with parent, observers = Set.empty
  submit parties.bob do
    exerciseCmd custodyRequestCid CustodyRequest_Accept
  custodyAgreements <- fmap snd <$> query parties.charlie
  let expectedCustodyAgreement = CustodyAgreement with
        parent
        account
        observers = Set.empty
  custodyAgreements === [expectedCustodyAgreement]
  custodianRoles <- fmap fst <$> query @CustodianRole (allParties parties)
  custodianRoles === [custodianRoleCid]

assertIsLeafNode : Account -> Update ()
assertIsLeafNode account = do
  custodialRole <- lookupByKey @CustodianRole account.id
  custodialRole === None

assertAtHierarchyTop : Account -> Update ()
assertAtHierarchyTop account = do
  (_, topCustodyAgreement) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement account.id
  rootCustodyAgreement <- lookupByKey @CustodyAgreement topCustodyAgreement.parent.id
  rootCustodyAgreement === None

getParent : Account -> Update Account
getParent account = do
  (_, custodyAgreement) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement account.id
  pure custodyAgreement.parent

-- | A call to allocate and/or deallocate from an account hierarchy.
template AllocationChangeInstruction
  with
    asset : Asset -- ^ Quantity and identifier of the asset to allocate and/or deallocate.
    deallocations : [DeallocationDetails] -- ^ Deallocations from bottom to top of the hierarchy.
    allocations : [AllocationDetails] -- ^ Allocations from top to bottom of the hierarchy.
    masterAgreement : MasterAgreement -- ^ Master agreement under which this applies.
    tradeId : Id -- ^ Trade this allocation change is linked to.
    observers : Set Party -- ^ Contract observers.
  where
    signatory masterAgreement.id.signatories,
      deallocationSignatories confirmedDeallocations,
      allocationSignatories confirmedAllocations
    observer masterAgreement.party1,
      masterAgreement.party2,
      deallocationSignatories unconfirmedDeallocations,
      allocationSignatories unconfirmedAllocations,
      observers

    key (masterAgreement.id, tradeId, asset.id) : (Id, Id, Id)
    maintainer key._1.signatories

    let (confirmedDeallocations, unconfirmedDeallocations) = splitDeallocations deallocations
        (confirmedAllocations, unconfirmedAllocations) = splitAllocations allocations

    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive : ()
      controller masterAgreement.id.signatories
      do
        pure ()

    -- | Account signatories of the next unconfirmed allocation can choose to consent to the allocation change. Can
    -- only be exercised after all deallocations are confirmed.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction
      controller (head unconfirmedAllocations).account.id.signatories
      do
        unconfirmedDeallocations === []
        let nextAllocation = head unconfirmedAllocations
        create this with
          allocations = confirmedAllocations <> ((nextAllocation with confirmed = True) :: tail unconfirmedAllocations)

    -- | Account signatories of the next unconfirmed deallocation can choose to consent to the allocation change.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation : ContractId AllocationChangeInstruction
      with
        depositCid : ContractId AssetDeposit -- ^ Deposit to archived during exercise of
        -- 'AllocationChangeInstruction_Process'.
      controller (head unconfirmedDeallocations).account.id.signatories
      do
        allocation <- fetch depositCid
        allocation.asset === asset
        let nextDeallocation = head unconfirmedDeallocations
        allocation.account === nextDeallocation.account
        let updatedNextDeallocation = nextDeallocation with depositCid = Some depositCid
        create this with
          deallocations = confirmedDeallocations <> (updatedNextDeallocation :: tail unconfirmedDeallocations)

    -- | Execute the allocation changes.
    choice AllocationChangeInstruction_Process : [ContractId AssetDeposit]
      controller masterAgreement.id.signatories
      do
        unless (null deallocations) do
          F.forA_ (zip deallocations (tail deallocations)) $ \(deallocation, nextDeallocation) -> do
            (_, custodialSerivce) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement deallocation.account.id
            custodialSerivce.parent === nextDeallocation.account
          F.mapA_ (\deallocation -> archive $ O.fromSome deallocation.depositCid) deallocations
          assertIsLeafNode (head deallocations).account

        unless (null allocations) do
          F.forA_ (zip allocations (tail allocations)) $ \(allocation, nextAllocation) -> do
            (_, custodyAgreement) <- fetchByKey @CustodyAgreement nextAllocation.account.id
            custodyAgreement.parent === allocation.account
          assertIsLeafNode (last allocations).account

        case (LT.last deallocations, LT.head allocations) of
          (Some topDeallocation, Some topAllocation) -> do
            deallocationParent <- getParent topDeallocation.account
            allocationParent <- getParent topAllocation.account
            unless (deallocationParent == allocationParent) do
              assertAtHierarchyTop topDeallocation.account
              assertAtHierarchyTop topAllocation.account
          (Some topDeallocation, None) -> assertAtHierarchyTop topDeallocation.account
          (None, Some topAllocation) -> assertAtHierarchyTop topAllocation.account
          (None, None) -> pure ()

-- | A record that combines an asset id and quantity. Can be used to
-- describe a quantified claim to an asset.
data Asset = Asset
  with
    id : Id
      -- ^ The asset id. Depending on the trust model, the signatories might
      -- be the issuer or a third party reference data provider such as Reuters.
    quantity : Decimal
      -- ^ The amount of assets with the specified id.
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- | A record that specifies a master agreement. Also includes the
-- counterparties because they cannot be looked up from another contract
-- when specifying choice actors.
data MasterAgreement = MasterAgreement
  with
    id : Id
      -- ^ References a master agreement via its id. Depending on the
      -- desired trust model, the signatories might be both counterparties
      -- or a third party agent.
    party1 : Party
      -- ^ Allows to specify choices of the first counterparty.
    party2 : Party
      -- ^ Allows to specify choices of the second counterparty.
  deriving (Eq, Show)

+module Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Allocation.Test where
+
+import DA.Assert ((===))
+import DA.Finance.Asset
+import DA.Finance.Types
+import qualified DA.Set as Set
+import Daml.Script
+import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Allocation
+import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Custody
+import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.TestUtils
+
+data Fixture = Fixture with
+  root : Account
+  left : Account
+  leftLeaf : Account
+  right : Account
+  rightLeaf : Account
+  asset : Asset
+  agreement : MasterAgreement
+  trade : Id
+  parties : Parties
+
+fixture : Parties -> Fixture
+fixture parties =
+  let root = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.alice
+      left = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.bob
+      leftLeaf = acc parties.alice parties.bob parties.charlie
+      right = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.david
+      rightLeaf = acc parties.alice parties.david parties.eve
+      asset = Asset with id = (acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.fred).id, quantity = 10.0
+      agreement = MasterAgreement with id = (acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.bob).id,
+        party1 = parties.bob, party2 = parties.david
+      trade = (acc parties.alice parties.fred parties.fred).id
+  in Fixture with root, left, leftLeaf, right, rightLeaf, asset, agreement, trade, parties
+
+instruction : Fixture -> [DeallocationDetails] -> [AllocationDetails] -> AllocationChangeInstruction
+instruction setup deallocations allocations = AllocationChangeInstruction with
+  asset = setup.asset
+  deallocations
+  allocations
+  masterAgreement = setup.agreement
+  tradeId = setup.trade
+  observers = Set.fromList (allParties setup.parties)
+
+debit : Account -> DeallocationDetails
+debit account = DeallocationDetails with account, depositCid = None
+
+credit : Account -> AllocationDetails
+credit account = AllocationDetails with account, confirmed = False
+
+createHierarchy : Fixture -> Script ()
+createHierarchy setup = do
+  let nobody = Set.empty
+  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.root, observers = nobody
+  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.left, observers = nobody
+  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.right, observers = nobody
+  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.root, account = setup.left, observers = nobody
+  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.left, account = setup.leftLeaf, observers = nobody
+  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.root, account = setup.right, observers = nobody
+  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.right, account = setup.rightLeaf, observers = nobody
+  pure ()
+
+test_confirmations_and_transfer : Script ()
+test_confirmations_and_transfer = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
+  let setup = fixture parties
+  createHierarchy setup
+  source <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AssetDeposit with
+    account = setup.leftLeaf, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty
+  other <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AssetDeposit with
+    account = setup.rightLeaf, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty
+  let proposed = instruction setup [debit setup.leftLeaf, debit setup.left]
+        [credit setup.right, credit setup.rightLeaf]
+  cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd proposed
+  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
+  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
+  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = other
+  first <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = source
+  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd first AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
+  parentDeposit <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AssetDeposit with
+    account = setup.left, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty
+  second <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd first AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = parentDeposit
+  third <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd second AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
+  fourth <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd third AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
+  [(_, state)] <- query @AllocationChangeInstruction parties.alice
+  state.deallocations === [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leftLeaf, depositCid = Some source,
+    DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some parentDeposit]
+  state.allocations === [AllocationDetails with account = setup.right, confirmed = True,
+    AllocationDetails with account = setup.rightLeaf, confirmed = True]
+  created <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd fourth AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
+  length created === 2
+  deposits <- fmap snd <"'$> query @AssetDeposit parties.alice
+  deposits === [AssetDeposit with account = setup.right, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty,
+    AssetDeposit with account = setup.rightLeaf, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty,
+    AssetDeposit with account = setup.rightLeaf, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty]
+
+test_rule_owner_and_next_account : Script ()
+test_rule_owner_and_next_account = withParties $ '"\\parties -> do
+  let setup = fixture parties
+  deposit <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AssetDeposit with
+    account = setup.leftLeaf, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty
+  leafRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.leftLeaf
+  parentRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.left
+  destinationRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.right
+  cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd "'$ instruction setup [debit setup.leftLeaf, debit setup.left] [credit setup.right]
+  submitMustFail parties.bob do exerciseCmd parentRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
+    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
+  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd leafRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
+    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
+  first <- submit parties.charlie do exerciseCmd leafRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
+    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
+  submitMustFail parties.david do exerciseCmd destinationRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextAllocation with
+    allocationChangeInstructionCid = first
+  parentDeposit <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AssetDeposit with
+    account = setup.left, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty
+  second <- submit parties.bob do exerciseCmd parentRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
+    allocationChangeInstructionCid = first, depositCid = parentDeposit
+  third <- submit parties.david do exerciseCmd destinationRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextAllocation with
+    allocationChangeInstructionCid = second
+  [(_, state)] <- query @AllocationChangeInstruction parties.alice
+  state.allocations === [AllocationDetails with account = setup.right, confirmed = True]
+  state.deallocations === [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leftLeaf, depositCid = Some deposit,
+    DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some parentDeposit]
+  _ <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd third AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive
+  pure ()
+
+test_process_rejects_invalid_hierarchy : Script ()
+test_process_rejects_invalid_hierarchy = withParties $ '"\\parties -> do
+  let setup = fixture parties
+  createHierarchy setup
+  let createAndReject debits credits = do
+        cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd "'$ instruction setup debits credits
+        submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
+        _ <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive
+        pure ()
+  createAndReject [] [credit setup.left]
+  createAndReject [] [credit setup.leftLeaf]
+  createAndReject [] [credit setup.root, credit setup.rightLeaf]
+  createAndReject [] [credit setup.left, credit setup.rightLeaf]
+  createAndReject [debit setup.leftLeaf] []
+  pure ()
+
+test_process_empty_and_single_branch : Script ()
+test_process_empty_and_single_branch = withParties $ '"\\parties -> do
+  let setup = fixture parties
+  createHierarchy setup
+  empty <- submit parties.alice do createCmd "'$ instruction setup [] []
+  emptyResult <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd empty AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
+  emptyResult === []
+  alloc <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup [] [credit setup.right, credit setup.rightLeaf]
+  created <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd alloc AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
+  length created === 2
+  first <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AssetDeposit with
+    account = setup.leftLeaf, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty
+  second <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AssetDeposit with
+    account = setup.left, asset = setup.asset, observers = Set.empty
+  debits = [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leftLeaf, depositCid = Some first,
+    DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some second]
+  dealloc <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup debits []
+  result <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd dealloc AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
+  result === []

item.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "cat > core-model/test/src/Synfini/AccountHierarchy/Allocation/Test.daml <<'EOF'
module Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Allocation.Test where

import DA.Assert ((===))
import DA.Finance.Asset
import DA.Finance.Types
import qualified DA.Set as Set
import Daml.Script
import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Allocation
import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Custody
import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.TestUtils

data Fixture = Fixture with
  root : Account
  left : Account
  leaf : Account
  right : Account
  destination : Account
  asset : Asset
  agreement : MasterAgreement
  trade : Id
  parties : Parties

fixture : Parties -> Fixture
fixture parties =
  let root = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.alice
      left = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.bob
      leaf = acc parties.alice parties.bob parties.charlie
      right = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.david
      destination = acc parties.alice parties.david parties.eve
      asset = Asset with id = (acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.fred).id, quantity = 10.0
      agreement = MasterAgreement with id = left.id, party1 = parties.bob, party2 = parties.david
      trade = (acc parties.alice parties.fred parties.fred).id
  in Fixture with root, left, leaf, right, destination, asset, agreement, trade, parties

instruction : Fixture -> [DeallocationDetails] -> [AllocationDetails] -> AllocationChangeInstruction
instruction setup deallocations allocations = AllocationChangeInstruction with
  asset = setup.asset
  deallocations
  allocations
  masterAgreement = setup.agreement
  tradeId = setup.trade
  observers = Set.fromList (allParties setup.parties)

debit : Account -> DeallocationDetails
debit account = DeallocationDetails with account, depositCid = None

credit : Account -> AllocationDetails
credit account = AllocationDetails with account, confirmed = False

createHierarchy : Fixture -> Script ()
createHierarchy setup = do
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.root, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.left, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.right, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.root, account = setup.left, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.left, account = setup.leaf, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.root, account = setup.right, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.right, account = setup.destination, observers = Set.empty
  pure ()

makeDeposit : Party -> Account -> Asset -> Script (ContractId AssetDeposit)
makeDeposit actor account asset = submit actor do createCmd AssetDeposit with account, asset, observers = Set.empty

test_confirmations_and_transfer : Script ()
test_confirmations_and_transfer = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  createHierarchy setup
  source <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf setup.asset
  wrong <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.destination setup.asset
  cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd "'$ instruction setup
    [debit setup.leaf, debit setup.left] [credit setup.right, credit setup.destination]
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = wrong
  different <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf (setup.asset with quantity = 5.0)
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = different
  first <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = source
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd first AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
  parentDeposit <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.left setup.asset
  second <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd first AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = parentDeposit
  third <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd second AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
  fourth <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd third AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
  [(_, state)] <- query @AllocationChangeInstruction parties.alice
  state.deallocations === [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leaf, depositCid = Some source,
    DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some parentDeposit]
  state.allocations === [AllocationDetails with account = setup.right, confirmed = True,
    AllocationDetails with account = setup.destination, confirmed = True]
  created <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd fourth AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  length created === 2
  deposits <- fmap snd <$> query @AssetDeposit parties.alice
  length deposits === 4
  length (filter ('"\\deposit -> deposit.account == setup.right && deposit.asset == setup.asset) deposits) === 1
  length (filter (\\deposit -> deposit.account == setup.destination && deposit.asset == setup.asset) deposits) === 2

test_rule_owner_and_next_account : Script ()
test_rule_owner_and_next_account = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  deposit <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf setup.asset
  leafRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.leaf
  parentRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.left
  destinationRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.right
  cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd "'$ instruction setup [debit setup.leaf, debit setup.left] [credit setup.right]
  submitMustFail parties.bob do exerciseCmd parentRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd leafRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
  first <- submit parties.charlie do exerciseCmd leafRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
  submitMustFail parties.david do exerciseCmd destinationRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextAllocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = first
  parentDeposit <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.left setup.asset
  second <- submit parties.bob do exerciseCmd parentRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = first, depositCid = parentDeposit
  third <- submit parties.david do exerciseCmd destinationRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextAllocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = second
  [(_, state)] <- query @AllocationChangeInstruction parties.alice
  state.allocations === [AllocationDetails with account = setup.right, confirmed = True]
  state.deallocations === [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leaf, depositCid = Some deposit,
    DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some parentDeposit]
  _ <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd third AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive
  pure ()

test_invalid_paths : Script ()
test_invalid_paths = withParties $ '"\\parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  createHierarchy setup
  let reject debits credits = do
        cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd "'$ instruction setup debits credits
        submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
        _ <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive
        pure ()
  reject [] [credit setup.left]
  reject [] [credit setup.destination]
  reject [] [credit setup.root, credit setup.destination]
  reject [] [credit setup.left, credit setup.destination]
  reject [debit setup.leaf] []
  reject [debit setup.leaf, debit setup.right] []
  pure ()

test_empty_and_single_sided_paths : Script ()
test_empty_and_single_sided_paths = withParties $ '"\\parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  createHierarchy setup
  empty <- submit parties.alice do createCmd "'$ instruction setup [] []
  emptyResult <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd empty AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  emptyResult === []
  alloc <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup [] [credit setup.right, credit setup.destination]
  created <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd alloc AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  length created === 2
  first <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf setup.asset
  second <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.left setup.asset
  let debits = [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leaf, depositCid = Some first,
        DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some second]
  dealloc <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup debits []
  result <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd dealloc AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  result === []
EOF
DAML_SDK_VERSION=1.17.1 daml test --project-root core-model/test --files src/Synfini/AccountHierarchy/Allocation/Test.daml 2>&1 | tail -85'

module Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Allocation.Test where

import DA.Assert ((===))
import DA.Finance.Asset
import DA.Finance.Types
import qualified DA.Set as Set
import Daml.Script
import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Allocation
import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.Custody
import Synfini.AccountHierarchy.TestUtils

data Fixture = Fixture with
  root : Account
  left : Account
  leaf : Account
  right : Account
  destination : Account
  asset : Asset
  agreement : MasterAgreement
  trade : Id
  parties : Parties

fixture : Parties -> Fixture
fixture parties =
  let root = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.alice
      left = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.bob
      leaf = acc parties.alice parties.bob parties.charlie
      right = acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.david
      destination = acc parties.alice parties.david parties.eve
      asset = Asset with id = (acc parties.alice parties.alice parties.fred).id, quantity = 10.0
      agreement = MasterAgreement with id = left.id, party1 = parties.bob, party2 = parties.david
      trade = (acc parties.alice parties.fred parties.fred).id
  in Fixture with root, left, leaf, right, destination, asset, agreement, trade, parties

instruction : Fixture -> [DeallocationDetails] -> [AllocationDetails] -> AllocationChangeInstruction
instruction setup deallocations allocations = AllocationChangeInstruction with
  asset = setup.asset
  deallocations
  allocations
  masterAgreement = setup.agreement
  tradeId = setup.trade
  observers = Set.fromList (allParties setup.parties)

debit : Account -> DeallocationDetails
debit account = DeallocationDetails with account, depositCid = None

credit : Account -> AllocationDetails
credit account = AllocationDetails with account, confirmed = False

createHierarchy : Fixture -> Script ()
createHierarchy setup = do
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.root, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.left, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent = setup.right, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.root, account = setup.left, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.left, account = setup.leaf, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.root, account = setup.right, observers = Set.empty
  _ <- submit setup.parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.right, account = setup.destination, observers = Set.empty
  pure ()

makeDeposit : Party -> Account -> Asset -> Script (ContractId AssetDeposit)
makeDeposit actor account asset = submit actor do createCmd AssetDeposit with account, asset, observers = Set.empty

test_confirmations_and_transfer : Script ()
test_confirmations_and_transfer = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  createHierarchy setup
  source <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf setup.asset
  wrong <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.destination setup.asset
  cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup
    [debit setup.leaf, debit setup.left] [credit setup.right, credit setup.destination]
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = wrong
  different <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf (setup.asset with quantity = 5.0)
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = different
  first <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = source
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd first AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
  parentDeposit <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.left setup.asset
  second <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd first AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextDeallocation with depositCid = parentDeposit
  third <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd second AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
  fourth <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd third AllocationChangeInstruction_ConfirmNextAllocation
  [(_, state)] <- query @AllocationChangeInstruction parties.alice
  state.deallocations === [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leaf, depositCid = Some source,
    DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some parentDeposit]
  state.allocations === [AllocationDetails with account = setup.right, confirmed = True,
    AllocationDetails with account = setup.destination, confirmed = True]
  created <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd fourth AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  length created === 2
  deposits <- fmap snd <$> query @AssetDeposit parties.alice
  length deposits === 4
  length (filter (\deposit -> deposit.account == setup.right && deposit.asset == setup.asset) deposits) === 1
  length (filter (\deposit -> deposit.account == setup.destination && deposit.asset == setup.asset) deposits) === 2

test_rule_owner_and_next_account : Script ()
test_rule_owner_and_next_account = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  deposit <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf setup.asset
  leafRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.leaf
  parentRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.left
  destinationRule <- submit parties.alice do createCmd AllocationChangeRule with account = setup.right
  cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup [debit setup.leaf, debit setup.left] [credit setup.right]
  submitMustFail parties.bob do exerciseCmd parentRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd leafRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
  first <- submit parties.charlie do exerciseCmd leafRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = cid, depositCid = deposit
  submitMustFail parties.david do exerciseCmd destinationRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextAllocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = first
  parentDeposit <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.left setup.asset
  second <- submit parties.bob do exerciseCmd parentRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextDeallocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = first, depositCid = parentDeposit
  third <- submit parties.david do exerciseCmd destinationRule AllocationChangeRule_ConfirmNextAllocation with
    allocationChangeInstructionCid = second
  [(_, state)] <- query @AllocationChangeInstruction parties.alice
  state.allocations === [AllocationDetails with account = setup.right, confirmed = True]
  state.deallocations === [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leaf, depositCid = Some deposit,
    DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some parentDeposit]
  _ <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd third AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive
  pure ()

test_invalid_paths : Script ()
test_invalid_paths = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  createHierarchy setup
  let reject debits credits = do
        cid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup debits credits
        submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
        _ <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Archive
        pure ()
  reject [] [credit setup.left]
  reject [] [credit setup.destination]
  reject [] [credit setup.root, credit setup.destination]
  reject [] [credit setup.left, credit setup.destination]
  reject [debit setup.leaf] []
  reject [debit setup.leaf, debit setup.right] []
  pure ()

test_empty_and_single_sided_paths : Script ()
test_empty_and_single_sided_paths = withParties $ \parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  createHierarchy setup
  empty <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup [] []
  emptyResult <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd empty AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  emptyResult === []
  alloc <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup [] [credit setup.right, credit setup.destination]
  created <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd alloc AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  length created === 2
  first <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf setup.asset
  second <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.left setup.asset
  let debits = [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leaf, depositCid = Some first,
        DeallocationDetails with account = setup.left, depositCid = Some second]
  dealloc <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup debits []
  result <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd dealloc AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  result === []
EOF

test_custody_request_and_role : Script ()
test_custody_request_and_role = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  let account = setup.leaf
  let parent = setup.left
  let request = CustodyRequest with parent, account
  signatory request === [parties.alice]
  observer request === [parties.bob]
  requestCid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd request
  submitMustFail parties.bob do exerciseCmd requestCid CustodyRequest_Accept
  roleCid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd CustodianRole with parent, observers = Set.empty
  submitMustFail parties.charlie do exerciseCmd roleCid CustodianRole_EnterCustodyAgreement with account
  agreementCid <- submit parties.bob do exerciseCmd requestCid CustodyRequest_Accept
  [(_, agreementState)] <- query @CustodyAgreement parties.alice
  agreementState === CustodyAgreement with parent, account, observers = Set.empty
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd agreementCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with newObservers = Set.singleton parties.fred
  updatedCid <- submit parties.charlie do exerciseCmd agreementCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with newObservers = Set.singleton parties.fred
  [(_, updated)] <- query @CustodyAgreement parties.alice
  updated === agreementState with observers = Set.singleton parties.fred
  _ <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd updatedCid CustodyAgreement_SetObservers with newObservers = Set.empty
  pure ()

test_custody_validity_and_request_outcomes : Script ()
test_custody_validity_and_request_outcomes = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  let invalid = CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.right, account = setup.leaf, observers = Set.empty
  ensure invalid === False
  submitMustFail parties.alice do createCmd invalid
  let valid = CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.left, account = setup.leaf, observers = Set.empty
  ensure valid === True
  let request = CustodyRequest with parent = setup.left, account = setup.leaf
  cancelled <- submit parties.alice do createCmd request
  submitMustFail parties.bob do exerciseCmd cancelled CustodyRequest_Cancel
  _ <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd cancelled CustodyRequest_Cancel
  rejected <- submit parties.alice do createCmd request
  submitMustFail parties.charlie do exerciseCmd rejected CustodyRequest_Reject
  _ <- submit parties.bob do exerciseCmd rejected CustodyRequest_Reject
  agreements <- query @CustodyAgreement parties.alice
  agreements === []

test_sibling_move_and_unrelated_branches : Script ()
test_sibling_move_and_unrelated_branches = withParties "'$ '"\\parties -> do
  let setup = fixture parties
  createHierarchy setup
  let sibling = acc parties.alice parties.bob parties.fred
  _ <- submit parties.alice do createCmd CustodyAgreement with parent = setup.left, account = sibling, observers = Set.empty
  source <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf setup.asset
  let debits = [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leaf, depositCid = Some source]

  [destinationCid] <- submit parties.alice do exerciseCmd cid AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
  [(_, destinationDeposit)] <- queryContractId parties.alice destinationCid
  destinationDeposit.account === sibling
  destinationDeposit.asset === setup.asset
  secondSource <- makeDeposit parties.alice setup.leaf setup.asset
  let secondDebits = [DeallocationDetails with account = setup.leaf, depositCid = Some secondSource]
  invalid <- submit parties.alice do createCmd $ instruction setup secondDebits [credit setup.destination]
  submitMustFail parties.alice do exerciseCmd invalid AllocationChangeInstruction_Process
EOF
